Using Caldera, defenders can emulate known threat actor behavior and perform other red team activity to evaluate their organization’s defensive capabilities, test analytics, and find detection gaps. As a modular tool based on the MITRE ATT&CK framework, Caldera is designed to be extensible, intelligence-driven, and automation-friendly.
